status.note: Candidate. Freeze stages reached: CAPTURED, VALIDATED (30/30), CHECKSUMMED, VERSIONED. NOT SIGNED_OFF, NOT FROZEN; lifecycle=COMPLETED (tournament is over but the record is not yet ARCHIVED for serving). The production freeze contract (wc-frozen-gate.ts) requires ALL of: signedOff:true + signOff.status:SIGNED_OFF + non-empty approvals + frozen:true + lifecycle:ARCHIVED + checksum recompute + integrity pass. ACTIVATION (governed flip, no code change): set signedOff:true, frozen:true, lifecycle:"ARCHIVED", freezeTimestamp, signOff.status:"SIGNED_OFF", signOff.approvals[…]. Never without recorded Business + Historical-Authority sign-off (DGP-001 G8).
